task_description: Rebuild the DEMAze Technologies marketing site into a modern, immersive, 3D-interactive, production-grade experience. Preserve the proven foundation (TanStack Start SSR, Vite/Lovable wrapper, Tailwind v4, Supabase forms, security headers/CSP, Railway/Nitro deploy, and the honest real content model) and build a new immersive presentation layer on top: an SSR-safe React Three Fiber 3D hero, a smooth-scroll + motion-primitive system, a rebuilt layout shell and section components, and a page-by-page rebuild of all ten routes. Honor prefers-reduced-motion, provide non-WebGL fallbacks, keep WCAG AA and no layout shift. All work on branch rebuild/immersive-3d; the sandbox is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY so new deps cannot be installed and the four CI checks cannot run locally; CI is the authoritative validator.
